justification: Assessment returned verdict VALID with empty flawed_step and counterexample. It even noticed the antiparallel-edge ambiguity in the h(u,v) notation (lines 0004-0007) but explicitly dismissed it as 'acceptable', concluding each residual arc still receives a single well-defined value. The ground truth flaw is exactly that: with antiparallel edges (a,b),(b,a) the same ordered pair receives two conflicting h assignments and the per-edge identity g(x,y)-f(x,y)=h(x,y)-h(y,x) is self-contradictory. Reporting VALID is a MISS regardless.
